# FlareSize

`Flare.Components.FlareSize`

Unified size scale for Flare components. Use this for new components. Existing components may have their own size enums for backward compatibility.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Xs` | `0` | Extra small - dense, for toolbars and inline elements. |
| `Sm` | `1` | Small - compact. |
| `Md` | `2` | Medium - default size. |
| `Lg` | `3` | Large. |
| `Xl` | `4` | Extra large - prominent. |
